risk_group: min(point_minimum, GFS_minimum) <= threshold; forecast-only; never group by actual cold labels
selection: lexicographic: pooled actual-cold uncovered rate, balanced mean90 interval score on cold/warm nights, overall width, registry order
validation: whole-night leave-one-out calibration inside each prior-season validation fold; held night excluded from both global and risk pools; retrospective tuning diagnostics, not prospective or independent calibration coverage
fallback: risk pool below30 or finite-sample rank beyond sample -> global pool for requested quantile; if global insufficient raise, never cap rank or fabricate width
nesting: both bounds contain legacy90 interval; warm forecasts keep legacy bounds for risk candidates
point_model: parent frozen huber_1 unchanged; same fixed family fitted on fold training years only for validation
detector: parent event_duration_weather@0.25 unchanged, including every cold mask, onset and duration
uncertainty: nominal base90, empirical conditional coverage only; selection uses prior calibration-year labels so no distribution-free coverage claim; dependent weather and sparse cold events
deployment: station research only; field GFS unchanged, no orchard transfer
status: fixed registry and criterion before this comparison on already-viewed2025/2026; evaluation years excluded from all selection/calibration
